source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), this **PSYKER** may pick 1 enemy unit that is **visible** to it and within 18" of it, then roll a D6:

- 1: D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** to this **PSYKER**’s own unit
- 2-5: D6 mortal wounds to that enemy unit
- 6: D3+3 mortal wounds to that enemy unit

A **[Lone Operative](vsdata:core-ability/lone-operative)** unit outside any **Attached unit** can be picked only if it is no more than 12" from this **PSYKER**.
